an5.110:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevituṃ.
an5.110:1.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an5.110:1.4: bahussuto hoti …pe… tathārūpāssa dhammā …pe… diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an5.110:1.5: āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an5.110:1.6: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti. akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an5.110:1.7: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhevadhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an5.110:1.8: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevitunti.
